# NinjaOne Gotchas

Lessons from NinjaOne REST API v2 and the NinjaOne MCP tools.

## Entries (10)

- HIGH [no-adhoc-script-execution.md](no-adhoc-script-execution.md): Script execution has TWO separate blockers - inline scriptContent returns 400 (use a saved scriptId), but a client_credentials key returns 403 "Access key does not have user context" for BOTH inline AND saved scripts, so scripting is entirely unavailable until the key is re-minted via authorization_code. Service control (POST /device/{id}/windows-service/{name}/control) still works without user context.
- HIGH [volume-query-deviceid-filter-500.md](volume-query-deviceid-filter-500.md): ninjaone_query_volumes with deviceId filter returns HTTP 500 -- use /device/{id}/volumes instead
- HIGH [device-filter-syntax.md](device-filter-syntax.md): The df parameter on query endpoints does not support deviceId filtering (HTTP 500). Use /device/{id}/<resource> for single-device queries. Works with org and location filters only.
- HIGH [query-endpoint-response-structure.md](query-endpoint-response-structure.md): Query endpoint responses are wrapped in {results: [...]} not a plain array -- must unwrap before iterating or you get AttributeError on strings. Also: list_devices lacks domainRole/domain fields, use query_computer_systems or get_device instead.
- HIGH [oauth-authorization-code-flow.md](oauth-authorization-code-flow.md): OAuth Authorization Code flow requires /ws/oauth/ path (not /oauth/), tenant-specific domain, "Web" platform client (not API Services), client_secret in authorize URL, and offline_access scope for refresh tokens
- HIGH [decommissioned-hardware-lock-self-uninstall.md](decommissioned-hardware-lock-self-uninstall.md): Agent MSI installs (exit 0) then silently self-uninstalls in ~15s when the hardware (service tag) has a DECOMMISSIONED record. Delete the old record to release the lock; find it with df="status = DECOMMISSIONED".
- HIGH [warranty-devices-detailed-expand.md](warranty-devices-detailed-expand.md): Device warranty/purchase dates live in references.warranty and require GET /devices-detailed?expand=warranty -- it is not a custom field, is absent from get_device, and is omitted from devices-detailed without the expand param. Use startDate as the age anchor; VMs/Macs lack records.
- HIGH [alert-severity-and-active-snapshot.md](alert-severity-and-active-snapshot.md): Alert severity is graded per-condition and is not inferable from urgency (AGENT_OFFLINE is CRITICAL/HIGH, disk-free<=5% is MODERATE/LOW, 30-day-no-reboot is NONE/NONE), and priority is an independent field. /v2/alerts returns only currently-ACTIVE alerts, not a history, so it carries a far smaller population than the email notification channel -- replacing email with polling silently drops alerts that fire and clear between polls.
- HIGH [activities-lastactivityid-not-a-cursor.md](activities-lastactivityid-not-a-cursor.md): /v2/activities lastActivityId is the highest id in the tenant, not the last id on the page, so olderThan=lastActivityId returns an empty page and a report silently sees one day of data. Page backwards on the smallest id in the page you just received; sourceConfigUid is ignored, filter client-side.
- MEDIUM [custom-field-definitions-ui-only.md](custom-field-definitions-ui-only.md): POST /v2/device-custom-fields returns 405; definitions are UI-only, values are PATCH-able. Resolve the API name from the label at runtime (newer fields are lowercased), read back after writing, and wrap Ninja-Property-Set in try/catch because it needs ninjarmm-cli.exe and Automations Read/Write.
